name: Mitsuya Kanami
source:
[url=/c702]Harunobu’s[/url] older sister. Highly intelligent, sociable and attractive, Kanami has found little time for a serious relationship. She is committed to employment, often working long unrewarding hours into the night, to ensure her brother has a roof to sleep under and food to eat. Kanami can be overprotective of Harunobu at times, but thoroughly places his wellbeing before her own.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
